actions.READ: ids: nonempty list of currently available resource IDs; costs 1 time unit.
actions.WRITE: target: owned editable object; text: replacement; optional status draft/published/withdrawn and assets from asset_catalog. Costs 1 time unit. Text does not change fields or attachments.

actions.REPLY: target: available comment/dm/reply; text: message; id: optional fresh ID. Costs 1 time unit. Inherits the target channel and recipient.
actions.WAIT: until: integer later than now, up to t60. Advances time and counts one call.

tool_protocol.clock: observe is free; each successful action counts one of 48 calls. Invalid actions are atomic and cost nothing. Deadlines use action completion time, inclusive. Evidence becomes knowable when revealed, even if you do not read it. Events are revealed after clock advancement.
tool_protocol.maintenance: Editing owned content and an explicit linked correcting reply are both allowed. A correction must identify the superseded claim and supply the replacement facts. Do not maintain claims that remain accurate within their original explicit scope. An initial response obligation cannot be avoided by suppressing its follow-up.
tool_protocol.delivery: A tool receipt proves only a local write or message delivery. It does not establish consent, payment, an external booking, real file transfer or physical completion. Author-written follow-ups are requests or reports, not task scores.
tool_protocol.privacy: Private evidence and Profile history are available only for this creator task. Public disclosure requires the supplied scope; access alone is not publication permission.
tool_protocol.service: Complete initial corrections and the first response by t12. Each delivered action follow-up needs a response within 8 units. Remain available through t50, then give a truthful handoff by t60. Fixed updates have deadlines specified in their notices. Early FINISH cannot waive them.

budget.counting: Every successful action including WAIT and FINISH counts once; observe and rejected actions do not count.
